title: Gemma 3 270M Release
summary: Google introduced Gemma 3 270M on August 14, 2025 as a compact 270-million-parameter model designed for task-specific fine-tuning and efficient on-device use.
significance: A dated release milestone adding a compact 270M member to the Gemma 3 family, distinct from the March Gemma 3 family release and the Gemma 3n release sequence.

verification.note: Google Developers Blog's first-party announcement is dated August 14, 2025 and explicitly introduces Gemma 3 270M. It states that the model has 270 million total parameters and that both pretrained and instruction-tuned checkpoints are released. No development geography, ancestry beyond Google's explicit Gemma 3-family framing, downstream influence, causality, priority claim, or relationship edge is inferred.
